subject.title: fix: OpenAI OAuth works behind fake-IP proxies

question: Should the exact-host fake-IP exception apply to the device-code OAuth token exchange as well as authorization-code and refresh exchanges?
rationale: The branch changes an SSRF policy boundary, while the existing device-code route appears to remain outside the exception; choosing whether that route is intentionally unsupported is a security and product-scope decision.

options.title: Cover all supported OAuth exchanges
options.body: Apply the same exact-host policy to the device-code token POST and prove authorization-code, refresh, and device-code behavior through a real fake-IP proxy.

options.title: Limit the scope explicitly
options.body: Keep the exception limited to authorization-code and refresh, document that device-code proxy DNS is unsupported, and narrow the PR claim accordingly.

recommendation.title: Cover all supported OAuth exchanges
recommendation.body: Apply the same exact-host policy to the device-code token POST and prove authorization-code, refresh, and device-code behavior through a real fake-IP proxy.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged adjacent OAuth work explicitly separated this policy question for later security review.
